select e.id, e.exam_name, e.category_id, e.paper_id, e.exam_description, e.start_time, e.end_time, e.duration, e.max_attempts, e.pass_score, e.total_score, e.exam_type, e.exam_mode, e.registration_required, e.registration_start_time, e.registration_end_time, e.auto_grade, e.result_publish_type, e.result_publish_time, e.allow_review, e.shuffle_questions, e.shuffle_options, e.monitor_mode, e.anti_cheat, e.certificate_template_id, e.status, e.creator_id, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, c.category_name, p.paper_name, p.total_score as paper_total_score, u.nick_name as creator_name, IFNULL(stats.registered_count, 0) as registered_count, IFNULL(stats.submitted_count, 0) as submitted_count, IFNULL(stats.passed_count, 0) as passed_count from exam_examination e left join exam_examination_category c on e.category_id = c.id left join exam_paper p on e.paper_id = p.id left join sys_user u on e.creator_id = u.user_id left join ( select exam_id, count(*) as registered_count, sum(case when exam_status in ('submitted', 'graded') or submit_time is not null then 1 else 0 end) as submitted_count, sum(case when is_passed = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as passed_count from exam_user group by exam_id ) stats on e.id = stats.exam_id
